SCI-FRUIT v0.1/r0.3 — FINAL FIXED-OPERATOR,
CANDIDATE-AUTHORITY, AND DELIVERY-CLOSURE DIRECTIVE

The SCI-FRUIT Stage B r0.2 architecture and three-document publication
structure are accepted as the basis for one final narrow revision.

Do not perform another broad FRUIT derivation.

Do not freeze or reuse the current r0.2 core source-inventory digest after any
byte change.

Preserve:

- SCI-FRUIT-NORMATIVE-CORE as the complete normative scientific source;
- the concise scientist rationale and actual engineering-conformance
  specification as separate views;
- 24 requirements, six assumptions, and twenty predictions with stable IDs;
- no approved numerical FRUIT method or route;
- FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD as a required-record family;
- candidate, accepted, and applied models as distinct objects and spaces;
- the applied model as the removal and rejoin operand;
- exact additive/reference/gauge/null-space compatibility;
- rho_k = y_k^in - Pi_k(m_k^applied);
- z_k = F_k(rho_k) + B_k(m_k^applied);
- the fixed-linearity hierarchy;
- general fixed-state differentiable response;
- all seven RF identities;
- all eight support/influence roles;
- model/prior-supported origin in unavailable measured modes;
- all four joint-covariance terms where required by the target law;
- physical-parent, fixed-realized-model, and conditional-NOI target laws;
- full-product versus zero-target-law NOI actions;
- exact product roles and bundle-required handoff;
- immutable request state and the nine-stage successful producer path;
- continuation, restart, retry, branch, terminal selection, and publication as
  separate identities;
- terminal-candidate comparability;
- local completion independent of absent downstream use;
- every current claim ceiling and nonclaim.

Do not inspect implementation, configuration, schemas, tests, audits, repairs,
reductions, generated products, operational behavior, performance records,
production material, Unity material, web sources, or undocumented practice.

======================================================================
1. DISTINGUISH OPERATOR-DEFINING STATE FROM INPUT-DEPENDENT
   APPLICATION COORDINATES
======================================================================

The current r0.2 wording freezes “every numerical coefficient” in RF-01/RF-02
and places prescribed coefficient recomputation in RF-03 unless an
induced-fixed-map proof is supplied.

That wording is too coarse for the exact admitted SCI-PTC fixed-subspace
application.

Define three different classes.

A. Operator-defining state and coefficients

These determine the input-output map and are frozen in a fixed-state response.
For the admitted PTC application they include, as applicable:

- frozen detector-loading subspace A_g;
- application metric/influence W_(g,t)^app;
- normal matrix G_(g,t)^app and its generalized inverse;
- fixed centering/additive reference lambda_g;
- detector/group binding;
- application support and output support;
- rank requirement and frozen tolerance;
- mask state;
- projection orientation and family;
- branch and generation;
- every other fact that changes the induced map.

B. Input-dependent internal application coordinates

These are numerical coordinates or intermediate solves evaluated from the
perturbed operand while the operator-defining state remains frozen.

For the admitted PTC route:

    m_hat_(g,t)^app(x)
      =
      x_(g,t) W_(g,t)^app A_hat_g
      [A_hat_g^T W_(g,t)^app A_hat_g]^+.

A changed value of this coordinate under a changed x is not by itself:

- coefficient relearning;
- operator re-resolution;
- a changed method;
- a changed operator generation;
- an RF-03 full-procedure response.

It is evaluation of the same fixed map.

C. Frozen numerical removed component

A component U_hat computed from one parent and then held numerically fixed
under perturbation defines the separately named affine subtraction family:

    A_sub,U_hat(Y') = Y' - U_hat

with input derivative:

    D A_sub,U_hat[H] = H.

This is not the ordinary fixed-subspace projection.

Do not use the word coefficient without identifying which of these three
scientific roles it denotes.

======================================================================
2. BIND THE EXACT FIXED-SUBSPACE PTC SPECIALIZATION
======================================================================

Without reauthoring PTC science, derive the exact conditional input-output map
from the admitted PTC_APPLICATION_REFERENCE.

For one frozen group/time application state:

    G_(g,t)^app
      =
      A_hat_g^T W_(g,t)^app A_hat_g;

    m_hat_(g,t)^app
      =
      x_(g,t) W_(g,t)^app A_hat_g
      [G_(g,t)^app]^+;

    z_(g,t)
      =
      x_(g,t)
      -
      m_hat_(g,t)^app A_hat_g^T.

Therefore, on the exact admitted support and rank domain:

    z_(g,t)
      =
      x_(g,t) P_(g,t,Theta)^PTC,

where:

    P_(g,t,Theta)^PTC
      =
      I
      -
      W_(g,t)^app A_hat_g
      [A_hat_g^T W_(g,t)^app A_hat_g]^+
      A_hat_g^T.

When A_hat_g, W_(g,t)^app, centering, support, detector binding, rank/tolerance,
branch, and every other operator-defining fact are fixed, this is one fixed
numerical map.

The RF-01 perturbation is then:

    delta z_(g,t)
      =
      delta x_(g,t) P_(g,t,Theta)^PTC.

The input-dependent modal coordinate is recomputed algebraically as part of
evaluating that same map.

For uncentered calibrated input with fixed lambda_g:

    x_(g,t) = Y_(g,t)^CAL - lambda_g;

    z_(g,t)
      =
      [Y_(g,t)^CAL - lambda_g] P_(g,t,Theta)^PTC;

    D_Y z[H]
      =
      H P_(g,t,Theta)^PTC.

This is a fixed affine map with fixed-state derivative P. Do not discard the
fixed additive term, and do not call the complete uncentered map strictly
linear.

If the perturbation causes lambda_g, A_hat_g, W^app, support, mask, detector
binding, rank state, tolerance, grouping, selection, or another
operator-defining fact to be relearned or re-resolved, the query is RF-03 or
another separately typed procedure response.

If the perturbed object leaves the exact finite/rank/support domain on which P
is defined, the affected RF-01 result is unavailable or a separately typed
state transition/discontinuity. It does not silently acquire RF-03 identity.

======================================================================
3. REPAIR RF-01/RF-02/RF-03 WORDING
======================================================================

RF-01 shall mean:

    perturb the declared iteration input while freezing the complete realized
    operator-defining state and complete induced numerical input-output map.

It shall permit internal coordinates that are functions evaluated by that
fixed map to change with the perturbation.

RF-02 shall analogously perturb the applied-model operand while freezing the
operator-defining maps/state, while evaluating every internal fixed-map
coordinate required by that applied-model action.

RF-03 shall rerun every method-prescribed operation that can change the
operator-defining map or consequential state, including:

- model construction or acceptance;
- loading subspace;
- metric;
- support or mask;
- centering/reference;
- rank state;
- grouping;
- selection;
- threshold;
- branch;
- another state-resolution rule.

Do not classify evaluation of an input-dependent coordinate under one unchanged
fixed map as RF-03 merely because that coordinate is commonly called a
coefficient.

Retain the generic rule that a recomputed quantity belongs to RF-03 when its
recomputation changes the operator-defining state or map.

Update consistently:

- the PTC application crosswalk;
- NormResponseLocal;
- NormState;
- REQ-011;
- REQ-012;
- REQ-013;
- PRED-006;
- PRED-009;
- PRED-010 where referenced;
- AMENDMENTS.md;
- PRODUCT_LIFECYCLE.md;
- METHOD_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md;
- R0.1_TO_R0.2_CROSSWALK.md;
- SEMANTIC_CHANGE_REPORT.md;
- rationale response explanation;
- ECS EV-005/EV-006 and associated fixtures;
- requirement-to-evidence and prediction-to-fixture indexes.

Preserve the existing stable IDs by amending their same obligations.

======================================================================
4. PRESERVE PTC OWNERSHIP
======================================================================

The repair above is a FRUIT response-classification crosswalk derived from the
exact admitted PTC equations.

It does not:

- alter the PTC estimator;
- select a new PTC family;
- alter rank or support;
- redefine PTC application coefficients;
- authorize a numerical FRUIT method;
- authorize a PTC or FRUIT route;
- establish response fidelity.

State explicitly:

    PTC owns the estimator and its exact fixed-state application map.
    FRUIT owns only the response role assigned to a declared use of that
    upstream operation inside a FRUIT method.

If the admitted PTC source is insufficient to establish one exact induced map
for a particular support/state, retain typed unavailability for that case.
Do not replace it with a generic “all coefficient recomputation is RF-03” rule.

======================================================================
5. REPAIR CANDIDATE/AUTHORITY AND REGISTRY LANGUAGE
======================================================================

The current package is an owner-review candidate, not yet frozen or activated.

Replace:

    complete sole active Stage B scientific authority as an owner-review
    candidate

with:

    complete sole current Stage B review-candidate normative core

or another wording that does not imply owner approval or activation.

Unless an exact content-bound FRUIT Registry record exists, replace:

    registered base products
    registered response products
    registered uncertainty family
    exact registry

with:

    core-declared product roles
    core-declared response-role vocabulary
    closed uncertainty-role grammar
    exact core declaration.

If an actual Registry is intended, create and bind separate states for:

    semantics_authored
    scientific_owner_approved
    registered
    source_bound
    activated.

No owner-review candidate may describe an unactivated Registry item as active.

Apply this wording consistently to:

- normative core;
- product/lifecycle table;
- model-uncertainty crosswalk;
- method-record template;
- semantic-change report;
- source and parity records;
- rationale and ECS covers;
- proposed owner disposition.

======================================================================
6. REPAIR EXTERNAL ARCHIVE/SIDECAR LINK STATUS
======================================================================

The archive cannot contain a local link to itself.

The current README and DOCUMENT_VERIFICATION each contain local Markdown links
to:

    SCI-FRUIT-v0.1-stage-b-r0.2-owner-review.tar.gz
    SCI-FRUIT-v0.1-stage-b-r0.2-owner-review.tar.gz.sha256

but those files are not members of the extracted delivery tree.

Treat them as external sibling delivery artifacts.

Do one of:

A. render the filenames as external-delivery code rather than in-tree Markdown
   links; or

B. provide a package-level landing document outside the archive whose links
   point to the archive and sidecar.

Narrow the verification statement to:

    every in-tree local Markdown link resolves inside the extracted delivery;
    the outer archive and its digest sidecar are separately verified external
    sibling artifacts.

Ship the external SHA-256 sidecar beside the final archive.

The reviewed r0.2 archive had:

    size:
      2519780 bytes

    SHA-256:
      6d552e49510c92fff65d9c835f8f31cd21f8ef50bed4f1a24ff355cfce7523a4

Do not reuse that digest after any byte change.

12. clean-build report;
13. all-page PDF visual/metadata report;

15. external archive and archive-digest sidecar;
16. proposed conditional scientific-owner disposition.

Verify:

- SCI-FRUIT-REQ-001 through REQ-024 remain unique and gap-free;
- SCI-FRUIT-ASM-001 through ASM-006 remain unique and gap-free;
- SCI-FRUIT-PRED-001 through PRED-020 remain unique and gap-free;
- ordinary fixed-subspace PTC projection is not confused with frozen-component
  subtraction;
- input-dependent internal coordinates are not confused with
  operator-defining state;
- fixed affine centering is not discarded;
- RF-01 and RF-03 have nonoverlapping causal meanings;
- no “active” or “registered” claim exceeds the candidate’s actual authority;
- all in-tree links resolve;
- every manifest and sidecar hash reproduces;
- no symlink, hard link, absolute path, or traversal member exists;
- every PDF reopens and renders without clipping, overlap, malformed equations,
  broken glyphs, unreadable tables, or accidental blank pages;
- owner, status, version, revision, date, source identities, and metadata agree.

======================================================================
8. FREEZE DISPOSITION
======================================================================

After this narrow repair, return the successor core for a separate explicit
Grant Wilson conditional-freeze decision.

A conditional freeze may preserve:

    every numerical FRUIT method/route
      =
    unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval.

It shall not establish:

- numerical FRUIT availability;
- implementation conformity;
- response or covariance fidelity;
- uncertainty coverage;
- recovered measured modes;
- convergence adequacy;
- Pointing, OOF, source, or catalogue fitness;
- observational validation;
- performance;
- readiness;
- production suitability or authorization;
- Unity activity.
